step_matches.reason: Both have the Bureau/Office Chief, designee or manager requesting a purchase card for the employee.
Both have the nominee completing and signing Form A-498.
Both have the nominee completing the GSA web-based purchase card training.
Both have the AO giving the cardholder written authorization for the purchase.
Both have the cardholder ensuring funds are available before the purchase.
Both have the cardholder completing and attaching the Section 508 Determination and Findings form.
No AI step has the cardholder completing other purchase card forms the AO requires.
Both have the cardholder making the purchase with the card.
Both have the AO validating receipt of the items and signing the receipt or invoice.
Both have the cardholder obtaining the accepting employee's signature and date on the invoice.
Both have the cardholder reconciling the monthly SOA.
AI S35 has the cardholder signing the reconciled SOA and forwarding it to the AO.
Both have the AO reviewing the reconciled SOA.
AI S38 has the AO signing the SOA and forwarding it to FOC RDG/TOG.
Both have the APC reviewing card usage to find inactive accounts.
Both have the APC giving the inactive account list to each Bureau/Office.
Both have the Bureau/Office confirming the continued need for the inactive account.
Both have the APC suspending the inactive account until confirmation is received.
Both have the reviewers conducting periodic or random reviews of cardholder transactions.
Both have the cardholder furnishing supporting documentation for the review.
Both have the cardholder reviewing receipts for the questioned transaction.
Both have the cardholder contacting the merchant to resolve the disputed charge and documenting the actions taken.
Both have the cardholder submitting a dispute request to the contractor bank.
Both have the AO or Bureau/Office Chief giving the APC prior notice of the transfer or separation.
Both have the cardholder providing purchase card records to the AO.
Both have the cardholder surrendering the card to the AO or APC.
Both have the AO noting on the final SOA that the departed cardholder could not sign it.
Both have the APC closing the cardholder's account.
Both have the Bureau/Office Chief designating a new AO; the AI puts the written notice to the APC in a separate step, S72.

decision_matches.reason: Both ask whether the item is covered by Section 508: Yes goes to the 508 form, and No continues the purchase preparation (the AI goes to its price check because it has no 'other forms' step).
Both ask whether another employee accepted or first used the goods: Yes goes to obtaining that employee's signature, and No goes to reconciling the SOA.
The AI has no explicit three-year inactivity decision; it folds the condition into step S50.
Both ask whether the Bureau/Office confirms the need: confirmation keeps the account, and no confirmation leads to suspension.
Both ask whether research confirms a dispute: Yes goes to contacting the merchant, and No ends.
Both ask whether the dispute was resolved with the merchant: Yes ends, and No goes to the bank dispute (the AI adds an extra shipping/tax branch).

Both ask whether the final SOA was available before the cardholder left: the AI phrases the condition inversely and closes the account earlier, but leaving before the SOA still leads to the AO's note on the SOA.
